task.description: Design the test coverage for OIDC-02. Create or update the requirement test spec and any required test sources so the run can validate that the Keycloak adapter implements the OIDC-01 contract, keeps Keycloak-specific coupling isolated to adapter modules, and preserves non-adapter compile boundaries. Keep the test plan focused on OIDC-02 acceptance criteria and the implemented backend surface.
acceptance_criteria: A test spec for OIDC-02 exists with acceptance-criteria traceability
Planned or added tests cover adapter conformance and non-adapter compile-isolation expectations
Artifacts clearly identify what TEST-RUNNER must execute for OIDC-02

result.summary: Designed the OIDC-02 test artifact with acceptance traceability to adapter conformance and non-adapter compile-isolation checks, plus explicit TEST-RUNNER commands for the mapped unit tests and source scan.
